audience_note: Animated movie — demon battles throughout; the villain preys on shame and fear.

episodes.title: KPop Demon Hunters
episodes.summary: K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey sell out stadiums by day and secretly defend their fans from demons by night — until a rival boy band, the Saja Boys, turns out to be demons stealing souls for their king, Gwi-Ma.
episodes.why: Sits in the gray area mainly on violence & injury (moderate, implied).
